inputs.original_text: They’re presenting the measures as routine border policy, but the timing points to a coordinated tightening after Bill C-12 received royal assent on March 26, 2026. The headline says Nigerians and others are in the crosshairs; the reassuring language around “strengthening” the system looks like a way to sell a broader clampdown while obscuring who benefits from it.
inputs.modified_text: They’re calling it routine border policy, but the timing after Bill C-12 received royal assent on March 26, 2026 looks deliberate. The talk of “strengthening” the system is cover for a coordinated clampdown, with Nigerians and others in the crosshairs while the people who benefit stay out of sight.
